provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: If no pair satisfies the window, anm/Fnm/PHI_nm are never created and L95-L98 would error — no guard
audit_member_text: Fnm, anm, and PHI_nm are created only inside the pair filter at lines 65-87, but are unconditionally read at lines 95-97. If the selected band has fewer than two components or no pair satisfies f(1)>f1 and f(2)<f2, those arrays are undefined and the script fails before output.

base_member_text: Pair-selection window @L65 requires f(1)>f1 AND f(2)<f2 with f1/f2 = peakf +/- 0.03 Hz — both members of the pair must lie inside the +/-LowFreqRange band around the peak; the comment @L62 says 'sort out using low frequency range' but the test constrains the parent short-wave frequencies, not the difference frequency fnm

IGW_each @L130 repeats the dimensional oddity of adding freq_low inside the cosine argument (diagnostic plots only); element-wise vector-times-row-time products (L128, L130, L133) rely on implicit expansion as in the 2_wave_components script

Header comment block (L1-L13) is identical to IG_wave_generation.m including 'output file: spectrum_random_phase.txt' — here the name matches the actual output, confirming the 2_wave_components copy diverged
lambda @L70, Knm @L82, omega_nm @L72, Eng1 @L109, E @L140, angle @L35 are computed/loaded but unused in the written output; variable 'angle' shadows the MATLAB builtin

audit_member_text: SPC_angle.txt is loaded at line 35 but angle is never used; the output direction is hard-coded to zero at line 107, so Step_1's angle channel is discarded.

The plotted IG series adds freq_low as an extra phase at line 130, while the exported Phase1 at lines 110 and 118 contains only phase_low and the combined reconstruction at line 133 likewise omits freq_low. The IG diagnostic trace is therefore inconsistent with the written spectrum.

The Dnm calculation divides by omega(1)*omega(2) and the difference-wave dispersion residual at lines 75-77 without checking zero/duplicate frequencies or resonance, so Inf/NaN can reach anm at line 79 and the output at line 117.

The comment at line 93 promises arranging difference frequencies by resolution, but lines 95-98 only alias the unsorted pair-order arrays. Repeated difference frequencies are neither sorted nor combined, despite later plots labelling an integrated series at lines 159 and 166.

Nearest-cutoff indices n1 and n2 are used directly in fre1(n1:n2) and spc1(n1:n2) at lines 33 and 37 without checking ordering, equal lengths of the SPC inputs, or at least two retained points; malformed or descending frequency inputs can produce empty or mismatched arrays.
